notes.title: Gate to Site 8 is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Gate to Site 8 has been released![/h1]

I'm happy to announce that you can now buy Gate to Site 8! 

It's a unique game and much like Faded Grey, is very loosely based on the Mothman urban legend, mixed with some inspiration from my own life. The legend has fascinated me for as long as I can remember, and making this game has been an amazing journey as a new indie dev.

Thank you all for your support and playing Faded Grey! It really means a lot!

You can purchase Gate to Site 8 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1527830/Gate_to_Site_8/]here[/url]. I truly hope you enjoy the journey. <3

Stay well,

Derek
